scripts.dev: node scripts/gen-flags.mjs dev && npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:local: node scripts/gen-flags.mjs local && npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:full: node scripts/gen-flags.mjs local && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run flags:prod && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:lambda: rm -f harbinger-backend.zip && (cd backend && npm ci --omit=dev) && zip -r harbinger-backend.zip backend/ -x '*.DS_Store' -x 'backend/.env*' -x 'backend/README.md' -x 'backend/node_modules/.cache/*' && echo 'Built: harbinger-backend.zip'
